title: Visual Animated X Posts at Scale
hook_angle: The bottleneck moved. Writing was never the hard part and the visual was, so TSX killed the visual cost. Then the constraint moved upstream to idea supply, and that is what a content pattern solves: a source that refills itself, a fixed unit, a locked shape. Two worked patterns (a 373-block book, and git commits from building ToolerBox in public), then the machine at scale: sketch-verify-then-TSX, a batch of 7 built in parallel with reserved design axes, and a free Playwright scheduler driving X's own native scheduler on two cookies.
notes: Planned 2026-08-10. Subject repo is D:\repos\my-x-growth-agent (private). Target 14-16 min, pattern-heavy split: Act 1 bottleneck ~3:30, Act 2 the pattern ~6:00, Act 3 the machine ~5:30. Act 2 is deliberately longest because the pattern is the transferable lesson and needs none of Hasan's code. B8 (source + unit + shape) is the hero shot. B11 demo is HYBRID: simulated Claude Code session in TSX, real 7-post output from blocks 21-27. Two lead magnets: the 373-block book (pitched inside B6, load-bearing) and a generic repo that DOES NOT EXIST YET. Full prep list in script/prep.md.
